portraitJobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. NEW portrait atlas for an island game. IMPORTANT USER REQUIREMENT: realistic NORMAL ADULT HUMAN BODY PROPORTIONS. No chibi, no huge heads, no doll or child proportions. Each WAIST-UP portrait has a normal adult head approximately one third of visible waist-up height, anatomically natural shoulders, long neck and torso, normal adult arms and hands. Heads should occupy about85px of the384px high cell, not half the cell. Adults aged20-40 except sailor aged55-65. Reference provided is ONLY for hairstyle, outfit COLOR, props and character identity; explicitly REPLACE its chibi anatomy with attractive natural adult human anatomy. Atlas exactly4x4, equal384x384 cells on1536x1536 square, true transparent background,15px transparent gutters, every torso and hand fully inside cell, no cell crossing, waist-up not legs. Beautiful polished hand-painted pixel-art illustration with crisp tiny pixels, nuanced adult faces, warm highlights. Row-major16 identities: row1 brown-braided straw-hat woman farmer with wheat; brown-haired goggle male carpenter in tan workwear with wood tool; lavender-haired beret woman party planner in lilac with ribbon; navy-haired male astronomer with blue star cloak and telescope. Row2 pink-haired flower-crowned female florist with bouquet; gray-bearded mature sea captain with white cap and blue vest holding rope; orange-haired woman baker in cream chef hat holding bread; dark-haired blue-beret male photographer with camera. Row3 teal-capped dark-haired fisherman holding lure; short green-haired female doctor in white coat holding herb sprig; purple-haired glasses woman librarian holding book; dark-haired male miner in yellow hardhat with small pickaxe. Row4 red-haired male musician wearing headphones holding guitar neck; pink-haired woman designer holding fabric and small scissors; pale blue-haired male curator with round spectacles and magnifying glass; elegant dark-haired male Hermes butler with white/teal coat and gold trim holding notebook. Hands at natural waist or chest height. Varied individualized welcoming and thoughtful expressions. Preserve distinctive identity/colors without childlike rendering. No text, no background, no frames. Normal adult head-to-body ratio is mandatory.
